يتبعثر (form IIq)
# يَتَبَعْثَرُ (yatabaʕṯaru) /ja.ta.baʕ.θa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# يُتَبَعْثَرُ (yutabaʕṯaru) /ju.ta.baʕ.θa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# يَتَبَعْثَرَ (yatabaʕṯara) /ja.ta.baʕ.θa.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
